ns2:section.sectionText: Description: This course is a special exploration course intended to engage women undergraduates majoring in mathematics, science, and engineering curricula in the fundamentals of game design using Macromedia Flash for the purpose of creating online games for local museum sites. Class meetings will take place at the WIMSE living/learning community. This course is restricted to students living in the WIMSE (Women in Mathematics, Science, and Engineering) living/learning community. Class will meet in Florida Avenue Residence Hall Room 5. Instructor permission required to enroll: Donna Michelle Hinn (hinn@uiuc.edu; Bertram (Chip) Bruce (chip@uiuc.edu).
